parties.respondent: The Deputy Director, Directorate of Enforcement

summary: Bail denial in money laundering case arising from job scam allegations as Transport Minister; predicate offences involve IPC/PoCA charges against 2000+ accused; disputed evidence includes seized pen drive (CS AC file discrepancies), unexplained cash deposits (Rs.1.34 cr in appellant's account); twin conditions under PMLA s.45(1)(ii) deemed unsatisfied; witness tampering concerns due to appellant's political position; reliance on Manish Sisodia for bail arguments rejected due to compromised witness integrity in prior cases.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act 1988 s.7, s.12, s.13(1)(d), s.13(2)
final_judgment: Bail appeal dismissed; High Court's bail rejection upheld; appellant remains in judicial custody.
